  --verbose   Muestra información técnica adicional junto al resultado en prosa.
  --debug     Muestra información técnica detallada para diagnóstico (incluye lo de --verbose).
              Si se usan ambas, --debug prevalece.

forge setup

forge workspace create <id> --root <path> [--name "..."] [--description "..."]
forge workspace scan
forge workspace info
forge workspace list
forge workspace use <id>

forge graph build
forge graph label
forge graph show
forge graph query <project> "<pregunta>"
forge graph explain <project> "<Nodo>"

forge knowledge sync
forge knowledge show
forge knowledge integration add "<titulo>" --target "<sistema>" [--protocol "..."] [--description "..."] [--from-task <id>]
forge knowledge constraint add "<titulo>" --description "..." [--from-task <id>]
forge knowledge risk add "<titulo>" --description "..." --severity <Low|Medium|High|Critical> [--from-task <id>]

forge decision create "<titulo>" --decision "..." [--problem "..."] [--context "..."] [--consequences "..."] [--author "..."] [--tags a,b]
forge decision list
forge decision show <id>
forge decision relate <id> --to <relatedId> --kind <Decision|Technology|Dependency|Architecture|Integration|Pattern|Constraint|Risk|Policy|Capability|TaskExecution> --type <RelatesTo|Supersedes|ConflictsWith|Implements|Mitigates>
forge decision supersede <oldId> <newId>

forge skill create "<nombre>" [--description "..."] [--category "..."] [--tags a,b]
forge skill list

forge capability create "<nombre>" [--description "..."] [--skills id1,id2]
forge capability list

forge policy create "<nombre>" --statement "..." --triggers "kw1,kw2" --severity <Warning|Blocked> [--global]
forge policy list
forge policy evaluate "<propuesta>"

forge prepare --workspace <id> --task "<descripcion>" [--projects a,b] [--budget 8000] [--objectives a,b] [--success a,b]
forge render claude [--package <id>]

forge task list [--workspace <id>]
forge tas
